dataset.hashDefinition: MD5 over ordered full-row JSON for existing class learning sessions and attempts; writing count and last-change timestamp are checked separately. This differs from the original historical fingerprint algorithm.
dataset.query: with f(side,class_id,teacher_id) as (values ('A','6f8002d4-e375-4490-91d1-ac8111c316de'::uuid,'50e19b9c-166a-48bf-b654-c702edcff815'::uuid),('B','69c3a01d-c393-4b0e-b085-23c8c89cd026'::uuid,'61ad0552-7bcb-480a-ba27-95c635326953'::uuid)) select side,(select count(*) from learning_sessions s where s.class_id=f.class_id) sessions,(select count(*) from attempts a join learning_sessions s on s.id=a.learning_session_id where s.class_id=f.class_id) attempts,(select max(s.updated_at) from learning_sessions s where s.class_id=f.class_id) latest_session_change,(select count(*) from written_work w where w.class_id in(select c.id from classes c where c.teacher_id=f.teacher_id)) writing_works,(select max(w.updated_at) from written_work w where w.class_id in(select c.id from classes c where c.teacher_id=f.teacher_id)) latest_work_change, md5(coalesce((select string_agg(to_jsonb(s)::text,'' order by s.id) from learning_sessions s where s.class_id=f.class_id),'')||coalesce((select string_agg(to_jsonb(a)::text,'' order by a.id) from attempts a join learning_sessions s on s.id=a.learning_session_id where s.class_id=f.class_id),'')) read_evidence_hash from f order by side
